model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for four different model configurations: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k)”, spans from 2⁰ to 2⁸ on a logarithmic scale, with tick marks at each power of two (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256). The y-axis, labeled “Coverage”, ranges from 0.4 to 0.8 in linear increments of 0.1. The blue solid line with circle markers representing Llama-3B starts at approximately 0.43 at k=1 and rises steadily to about 0.86 at k=256. The green dashed line with triangle markers for Llama-3B + FT begins at roughly 0.45 and increases to approximately 0.84 at k=256. The light blue dotted line with circle markers for Llama-1B starts at about 0.30 and climbs to 0.81 at k=256. The light green dash-dotted line with triangle markers for Llama-1B + FT begins at approximately 0.32 and reaches about 0.80 at k=256. All lines show a monotonically increasing trend, with Llama-3B achieving the highest coverage across all values of k.
